body.statement: The expanded-state transport network has \(2L^2+4L+1\) admissible arcs, and its feasible couplings are in bijection with realized-arm joint distributions induced by laws in \(\mathcal M_L\). The decoder preserves \((s,h)\); unused potential outcomes may be completed arbitrarily.
body.justification: The decoder supplies an independent finite-dimensional sharpness certificate and a destructive check on missing-outcome handling.
body.gap: Generic transportation representations do not identify which network coordinates equal same-layer harm under multilayer missingness.
body.consumer: Auditors of bounds software for protocol-controlled tier assignments obtain a latent-cell program against which the closed form can be tested.
